decision: Whether the offer is understandable and desirable
hypothesis: Qualified growth-agent teams understand the 50-Creator Live Pilot and prefer managed operations to a repository
audience: 10 growth-agent agencies or UGC-heavy B2C teams with live creator outreach
primary_event: Qualified reply that includes a real campaign/list and willingness to connect a sender
success_rule: At least 3 qualified replies; at least 2 agree in principle to connect a real sender; at least 1 accepts the paid-pilot terms
failure_rule: Fewer than 2 teams will connect a sender or all ask only for source code

decision: Whether the product can fulfill the promised job
hypothesis: Existing Switchboard transport plus a thin campaign layer can complete a real campaign without customer babysitting
audience: First one or two qualified pilot customers
primary_event: 50 real targets reach valid terminal states with replies routed to the customer's agent
success_rule: At least 90% of eligible targets reach sent or an explained safe skip; zero unplanned customer interventions; every reply delivered; recovery incidents logged
failure_rule: Unexplained target loss account damage repeated manual babysitting or inability to recover within the pilot window

decision: Whether relationship-aware voice is differentiated value
hypothesis: Profile and relationship context reduces substantive edits and increases positive-reply quality versus template personalization
audience: Targets within the same approved pilot
success_rule: Blindly randomized approved messages show lower substantive-edit rate and directionally higher positive replies for context-aware variant
failure_rule: No edit/reply-quality difference or context generation creates excessive review burden
ceiling: One campaign; report uncertainty; no significance claim from tiny sample

decision: Whether willingness to pay survives successful fulfillment
hypothesis: At least one activated pilot customer will pay for continued managed operation
primary_event: Recurring payment or signed paid continuation
success_rule: One customer pays or contractually commits to the next managed month at a price consistent with delivery cost
failure_rule: Customers activate but all churn to self-hosting or refuse recurring payment
